Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?

Yes, you can cancel, but there's a time limit. Most orders have a 4-hour review period after placing them, during which you can cancel from the "Cancel Order" button in your order confirmation email or from the Orders section of your account.

Once that 4-hour window closes, the order can't be cancelled or changed, since it moves into production.

Can I combine two separate orders into one shipment?

Combining two orders into one shipment isn't something we can do. Each order is custom-made and processed separately, so they stay as their own shipments.

If both orders were just placed and are still within the 4-hour review period, you could cancel both and place a single new order with everything together. That would ship as one order.
